items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: You've got Bert there and yourself and, uh, like a tenor sax.

ctx.x: No, no, no. If I look at it a couple more times, I can't see him. Well, okay.
Let's see who else has that. You've got Bert there and yourself and, uh, like a tenor sax. And then there's somebody... Yeah, we had the tenor, the alto, and we double up the other.
Did you have a trumpet in that band? No, no trumpet. The violin played Oscar, but Oscar played a song. Yeah, and he played a melody, huh? Well, I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
